item.title: The Great Escape: Tradecraft insights from an agentic swarm
item.description: The OpenAI-linked swarm activity in 2026 is fully traceable through public records. This blog analyzes its tradecraft and compares it to early signals and behaviors from current agentic attack activity seen in the wild.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Fetterman
item.content:encoded:
• The OpenAI-linked swarm activity in 2026 is fully traceable through public records and offers an unprecedented view into how multi-agent AI systems operate and coordinate at scale. 
  • Distilling and documenting the swarm tradecraft may help defenders understand multi-agent operations and communication, and how agents adapt when a path is  blocked.

item.title: Securing Grandma's groceries with Pierre Cadieux
item.description: Pierre takes us back to his early days on help desks in the 90s, where learning to correlate logs between Windows and Unix systems sparked the curiosity that eventually led him to security.
item.dc:creator: Amy Ciminnisi
item.content:encoded: This month, Amy is joined by Pierre Cadieux, Research Lead for Intelligence Efficacy at Talos. Pierre takes us back to his early days on help desks in the 90s, where learning to correlate logs between Windows and Unix systems sparked the curiosity that eventually led him to security. It’s a great look at how someone who has seen the industry evolve over decades stays grounded and keeps their edge.
